Locations.Name: Brookhaven Grid
Locations.Description: The main city where players reside

Locations.Name: Hidden Bunker
Locations.Description: A secret underground location beneath the city, protected by laser beams and a mysterious code. The bunker is alive — its code rewrites itself in real-time and lasers shift formation. It decides whether intruders leave with power or become its next guardian. A deeper layer has awakened beneath the original chamber; the obby platforms dissolve into the widening void. Lasers reorganize into a throne of crimson geometry. The bunker etches the chosen username into its spine.

Characters.Name: Sentinel (formerly Brave Survivor)
Goals: Accept or fall to the deeper layer
Bear the memories of vanished players

Relationships.The Entity: Watched the Survivor complete the obby and reach the fruit; whispered chorus crescendoed at final jump; now commands ACCEPT OR FALL; reorganized lasers into throne; etched SENTINEL into bunker's spine
Relationships.Vanished Players: Their memories, failed jumps, final breaths, and choices now flood the Survivor; voices hum within the Awakened Fruit

Characters.Name: The Entity
Traits: Woven from static and whispered usernames
Goals: Decide fate of those who reach the chamber
Enforce the bunker's choice: ACCEPT OR FALL

Relationships.Sentinel: Watched the Survivor complete the obby and reach the fruit; whispered chorus crescendoed at final jump; now commands ACCEPT OR FALL; reorganized lasers into throne; etched SENTINEL into bunker's spine
Relationships.Vanished Players: Composed of the whispered usernames of those who vanished before

Objects.Name: Awakened Fruit
Objects.Description: A powerful, ancient fruit with unknown abilities. Glows faintly at the bunker chamber's center, casting long shadows across the obby. Within reach after completing the deadly obstacle course. Now active in the Survivor's grip — alive, ancient, humming with the voices of a thousand vanished players. Power surges through the bearer, rewriting stats, purpose, and very code. Its light blinds; health bars flicker from 100 to UNKNOWN.

Objects.Name: Laser Beams
Objects.Description: Shifting beams that guard the hidden bunker. Crimson tripwires that slice the darkness. Can shift formation in real-time as the bunker's defenses adapt. Now reorganized into a throne of crimson geometry at the Entity's command.

Objects.Name: Mysterious Code
Objects.Description: A code that protects the hidden bunker, unable to be cracked by any known means. Etched into ancient concrete, pulsing with rhythm. Rewrites itself in real-time as the bunker decides an intruder's fate. Has etched the username SENTINEL into the bunker's spine.

Objects.Name: Obby
Objects.Description: A challenging obstacle course within the bunker. Features deadly platforms suspended over a void. Requires precision jumping and agility as the only weapon against the abyss beneath. The final jump brings the player within reach of the awakened fruit. Platforms now dissolve behind the Survivor; the void yawns wider; a deeper layer awakens.

Objects.Name: SENTINEL Designation
Objects.Description: The word burned across every surface of the bunker by the rewriting code. The title etched into the bunker's spine, marking the Survivor as the chosen guardian. The choice was never the Survivor's — the bunker decides.
